text.hi: आज की कहानी: ‘Where is Moti?’ (मोती कहाँ है?)। पहले कुछ शब्द सीखते हैं।
text.hinglish: Aaj ki kahani: ‘Where is Moti?’ (Moti kahan hai?). Pehle kuch shabd seekhte hain.
text.en: Today's story: ‘Where is Moti?’. First, a few words.

text.hi: ‘joy’ मतलब खुशी। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘joy’ matlab khushi. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘joy’ means खुशी. Tap to listen, then say it.

text.hi: ‘garden’ मतलब बगीचा। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘garden’ matlab bageecha. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘garden’ means बगीचा. Tap to listen, then say it.

text.hi: ‘bush’ मतलब झाड़ी। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘bush’ matlab jhaadi. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘bush’ means झाड़ी. Tap to listen, then say it.

sentences: Every morning he waits at the door for me.
When I come back from school, he jumps with joy.
One day Moti was not at the door.
I looked everywhere, but I could not find him.
Then I heard a bark from the garden.
Moti was sleeping under a bush!
I was so happy to see him again.

question.hi: मोती हर सुबह कहाँ इंतज़ार करता है?
question.hinglish: Moti har subah kahan intezaar karta hai?
question.en: Where does Moti wait every morning?
